messages:
Maria Chen: Quick follow-up from the RFC — do we want the runtime to support per-layer FP8 fallback limited to attention kernels, or a broader int4/fp8 fallback across matmuls too? Tradeoffs: quality risk vs cost.
Owen Patel: I'd bias toward attention-only FP8 fallback initially. Attention dominates memory bandwidth and KV cache ops, so FP8 there gives most savings while limiting degradations. Int4 on matmuls is riskier for many models.
Sophia Reyes: Re: risk — we should define a measurable quality SLO (e.g., regression <= 0.5% accuracy drop on eval-suite) before promoting to production. Also need telemetry per-sample: confidence + delta-score.
Arman Malik: Proposal: add a "precision_score" field in quant profiles (0-1) and a runtime negotiation: runtime advertises capability, scheduler evaluates cost/quality, then runtime can enable per-layer fallback if precision_score >= threshold.
Maria Chen: Example config I sketched:
```
{
  "policy": "attn-first-hybrid",
  "fallback_threshold": 0.92,
  "layers": {
    "attention": { "allow_fp8": true },
    "ffn": { "allow_int4": "experimental" }
  },
  "telemetry": ["sample_delta","confidence", "latency"]
}
```
Owen Patel: +1 to the config. Also: runtime should support immediate per-request override (headers) for customers to opt out.
Sophia Reyes: Operational notes: add automated A/B run for every quant-profile change. Baseline vs quant-run with sample-weighted metrics, and a rollback hook if quality crosses threshold. /cc @infra-bot can we wire the job?
infra-bot: scheduled job: `quant-profile-canary` — started 2239511000, running on pool:canary-gpu-1. Will post results in ~2 hours.
Arman Malik: Implementation note: keep the negotiation low-cost — token-level decisions only when KV-cache hit rates are high; otherwise use cached policy per-request.
Maria Chen: Decision (tentative): implement "attn-first-hybrid" mode + precision_score telemetry + per-request override. Run two canaries (small models + large model) and evaluate. If canaries pass, expand to dedicated pool.
Owen Patel: Sounds good. I'll own the runtime patch. Sophia: can you own canary eval harness? :+1:
Sophia Reyes: Yep, will set up eval and dashboard. Adding a short checklist to the RFC follow-up.
Maria Chen: Thanks everyone — we'll sync next week with preliminary canary results. :rocket:
